engine.candidate.no-filter.label: No filters (reference)
engine.candidate.no-filter.summary: Your tablet as it is, with no filters. Used as the baseline to compare everything else.

engine.candidate.balanced.label: Balanced
engine.candidate.balanced.summary: Moderate smoothing with little added delay.
engine.candidate.smooth.label: Smooth
engine.candidate.smooth.summary: The steadiest cursor, accepting a bit more delay.

engine.reason.candidate_no-filter: No filters: this measures how your tablet behaves on its own.
engine.reason.candidate_low-latency: Built to add as little delay as possible.
engine.reason.candidate_balanced: Built to balance cursor stability and delay.
engine.reason.candidate_smooth: Built for the steadiest cursor, at the cost of a bit more delay.
engine.reason.candidate_keep-current: This is your current profile, unchanged.
engine.reason.area_style_finger: Finger play usually works with a small area (about {min:g}-{max:g} mm wide).
engine.reason.area_style_wrist: Wrist play usually works with a small-to-medium area (about {min:g}-{max:g} mm wide).
engine.reason.area_style_mixed: Mixed wrist and arm play usually works with a medium area (about {min:g}-{max:g} mm wide).
engine.reason.area_style_arm: Arm play usually works with a large area (about {min:g}-{max:g} mm wide).
engine.reason.area_map_jumps: You prefer jumps: the area is a bit smaller so jumps need less hand movement.
engine.reason.area_map_streams: You prefer streams: the area is a bit larger for finer, steadier control.
engine.reason.area_skill_beginner: As a beginner, a slightly larger area makes small hand shakes less visible.
engine.reason.area_skill_advanced: As an advanced player, the area is slightly smaller.
engine.reason.area_heuristic: These sizes are common community starting points, not exact rules: adjust them to your hand.
engine.reason.area_preferred: You asked to keep an area {width} mm wide, so that size is kept.
engine.reason.area_clamped_tablet: A {wanted} mm wide area does not fit on your tablet ({tablet_w} x {tablet_h} mm) with your screen's proportions, so it was reduced to {width} mm.
engine.reason.area_clamped_min: The requested area was too small to play; it was raised to {width} mm wide.
engine.reason.area_aspect: The area ({width} x {height} mm) keeps the proportions of your {width_px}x{height_px} screen, so circles stay round.
engine.reason.area_centered: The area is centered on the tablet.
engine.reason.area_rotation_kept: Your area rotation ({rotation:g} degrees) is kept.
engine.reason.jitter_measured_high: We measured noticeable cursor shake while holding still ({jitter} mm, about {px} px).
engine.reason.jitter_measured_low: Cursor shake while holding still is low ({jitter} mm, about {px} px).
engine.reason.jitter_reported: You said you notice the cursor shaking.
engine.reason.rate_low: We measured about {measured} reports per second, below what your tablet can do ({hardware}). Check the USB port/cable or other drivers.
engine.reason.priority_latency: You prioritized low delay, so filtering is lighter.
engine.reason.priority_smoothness: You prioritized a smooth cursor, so filtering is stronger.
engine.reason.input_lag_reported: You said you notice input lag, so filtering is lighter.
engine.reason.resampler_added: Your screen ({refresh} Hz) refreshes much faster than the tablet reports (about {rate} per second): Temporal Resampler fills the gaps for a fluid cursor.
engine.reason.resampler_smoothing: Smoothing is done by Temporal Resampler itself ({latency} ms) instead of chaining a second timed filter.
engine.reason.noise_filter_added: {filter} was added to remove shake when the pen is still.
engine.reason.noise_filter_missing: No dedicated anti-shake filter is installed; the smoothing filter is set to also reduce shake.
engine.reason.no_smoother_available: No smoothing filter is installed, so this option cannot add smoothing.
engine.reason.nothing_to_add: With the filters you have installed this option ends up without filters.
engine.reason.frequency_default: The Frequency of {filters} stays at its default (1000 Hz): it is the filter's own timer, not your tablet's report rate, so it should not be changed.
engine.reason.latency_estimate: Estimated added delay: about {ms} ms (a rough estimate, not a measurement).
engine.reason.latency_unknown_filter: We cannot estimate the delay added by {filter}.
engine.reason.refine_more_smoothing: Small adjustment: {filter} {param} raised from {old} to {new} {unit} (more smoothing).
engine.reason.refine_less_smoothing: Small adjustment: {filter} {param} lowered from {old} to {new} {unit} (less delay).
engine.filter.noise_reduction.summary: Averages the last few pen positions and ignores tiny movements: removes shake when holding still.
engine.filter.noise_reduction.latency: Adds delay only for very small movements; it catches up as soon as the pen moves past the distance threshold.
engine.filter.hawku_smoothing.summary: Classic smoothing: the cursor follows the pen gradually. More latency = smoother but later.
engine.filter.hawku_smoothing.latency: Adds roughly the configured latency in milliseconds. Below about 4 ms it is better to disable it; about 50 ms is the usual maximum for osu!.
engine.filter.devocub_antichatter.summar: Smoothing that is strong for slow, small movements (shake) and light for fast ones. Mainly useful for tablets without hardware smoothing.
engine.filter.devocub_antichatter.latenc: For fast movements it adds less than the configured latency; slow movements are delayed more.
engine.filter.temporal_resampler.summary: Predicts and interpolates between tablet reports so a low report rate looks fluid on a high refresh rate screen.
engine.filter.temporal_resampler.latency: Prediction ratio 0 adds one report interval, 0.5 half of one, 1 none; its smoothing latency adds on top.
engine.filter.radial_follow.summary: The cursor may trail the pen by at most a small radius: steady on small movements, fast jumps stay sharp.
engine.filter.radial_follow.latency: Delay is limited to the outer radius, so it is small for fast movements.
engine.filter.saturn_multifilter.summary: Advanced antichatter with prediction and interpolation. Many options; for experienced users.
engine.filter.saturn_multifilter.latency: Its author claims virtually no extra latency; not independently verified.
engine.filter.saturn_area_rounding.summa: Advanced: reshapes the area depending on the distance from the screen center. Not a smoothing filter.
engine.filter.saturn_area_rounding.laten: Does not add delay; it changes the cursor mapping.
engine.filter.chatter_exterminator_smoot: Light antichatter on tablet coordinates; also evens out movement when screen and area proportions differ.
engine.filter.chatter_exterminator.laten: Described by its author as low latency; no figures are published.
engine.candidate.community.label: Community: {name}
engine.candidate.community_user.label: Your own values (unverified)
engine.candidate.community.summary: A published community setup adapted to your area. It is a starting point to measure, not a proven optimum.
engine.candidate.tune-less.label: Your filters, a bit lighter
engine.candidate.tune-less.summary: Your current filters with one parameter lowered (less smoothing, less delay).
engine.candidate.tune-more.label: Your filters, a bit stronger
engine.candidate.tune-more.summary: Your current filters with one parameter raised (more smoothing).
engine.reason.candidate_tune-less: Keeps your filters and lowers one value for less delay.
engine.reason.candidate_tune-more: Keeps your filters and raises one value for a steadier cursor.
engine.reason.tune_only_kept: Your filters and their order stay as they are (you chose "only tune my current filters").
engine.reason.tune_only_no_profile: You chose to only tune your current filters, but no OpenTabletDriver profile was found, so there is nothing to tune.
engine.reason.prediction_policy_unknown: This option uses a prediction setting (Prediction Ratio / frameShift). osu! announced on 2026-10-14 that smoothing is allowed but input-assisting plugins get actioned, without naming plugins; whether prediction counts is not known (https://osu.ppy.sh/community/forums/topics/2254092).
engine.reason.community_source_undated: Published by {name} ({source}); the source has no date, retrieved {retrieved}.
engine.reason.community_user_values: These are values you provided ({name}). They are unverified and not attributed to any player.
engine.reason.community_confidence_high: Source confidence: high (the player's own profile or self-entered setup).
engine.reason.community_confidence_mediu: Source confidence: medium (wiki/secondary source, or the entry has warnings).
engine.reason.community_starting_point: Community values are a starting point: it is measured like every other option and only wins if it measures better for you.
engine.reason.community_tune_only: Only the values of filters you already use were taken from this setup.
engine.reason.community_enabled_unclear: The source does not show clearly whether this filter was switched on.
engine.reason.community_px_unscaled: {filter} uses screen pixels; their real size depends on the source's screen and area, which are unknown, so the values are used as published.
engine.reason.community_raw_units: {filter} uses raw tablet units, which depend on the tablet's resolution; the values are used as published.
engine.reason.community_frequency_reset: {filter}: the published Frequency ({value}) was reset to 1000 Hz; it is the filter's own timer, not your report rate.
engine.reason.community_prediction_off: {filter}: prediction was switched off. The assistant never turns prediction on for you.
engine.reason.community_clamped: {filter} {param}: the published value {value} is outside the safe range and was limited to {new}.
engine.reason.community_area_unknown: {filter}: the area these values were used with is unknown, so they are used as published.
engine.reason.community_area_similar: {filter}: the source area is almost the same as yours, so the values are kept.
engine.reason.community_scaling_rule: Radial Follow radii are millimetres on the tablet, so they were scaled from the source area ({src_w} x {src_h} mm) to yours ({w} x {h} mm). This is a heuristic based on how the popular Mixmg calculator works, not a rule from the plugin author.
engine.reason.community_area_far: The source area is very different from yours, so the adapted values are less reliable.
engine.reason.community_flag_enabled_unc: Warning: in the source screenshot it is unclear whether the filter was enabled.
engine.reason.community_flag_area_mismat: Warning: the filter values match a different area than the one shown next to them; the setup may have changed over time.
engine.reason.community_flag_possible_ty: Warning: one value of this entry looks like a typo.
engine.reason.community_flag_missing_plu: Warning: the player also uses a plugin whose settings were not published.
engine.reason.community_flag_tablet_spec: Warning: some values depend on the player's tablet model (hardware smoothing).
engine.reason.community_flag_frequency_c: Warning: the source's Frequency advice conflicts with how the plugin uses it.
engine.reason.community_flag_stale: Warning: this source is old; the player may use something else now.
engine.reason.community_flag_untouched_d: Warning: these values equal the website's form defaults and may not have been set on purpose.
engine.reason.community_flag_prediction: Warning: the source uses prediction, which the assistant keeps off.
engine.reason.community_flag_conflicting: Warning: different sources disagree about this player's setup.
engine.reason.community_flag_partial_val: Warning: the source only gives some of the values; the others are plugin defaults.
engine.reason.community_flag_unverified: Warning: not verified by any public source.
engine.suggest.reason_engine: {filter} is not installed; the assistant would have used it for your measurements.
engine.suggest.install_hint: Install "{plugin}" yourself from OpenTabletDriver (Plugins > Open Plugin Manager), restart OpenTabletDriver and run the assistant again. The assistant never installs plugins.
engine.compare.area: Their area {w} x {h} mm, yours {my_w} x {my_h} mm.
engine.compare.only_theirs: They use {filter}; your result does not.
engine.compare.only_mine: Your result uses {filter}; they do not.
engine.compare.param: {filter} {param}: yours {mine}, theirs {theirs} adapted to your area (published {published}).
engine.compare.same: Same filters with values within 5% of each other.
engine.policy.input_assist: Never turned on automatically. It predicts the cursor ahead of the pen. osu! announced on 2026-10-14 that smoothing and anti-jitter plugins are fine but plugins that assist input will lead to action; no plugin was named (https://osu.ppy.sh/community/forums/topics/2254092). Using it is your decision.
engine.policy.user_decision: Never turned on automatically: it is not a smoothing filter (it changes which reports count or how the area maps). Your decision only.
engine.policy.prediction_param: Its prediction option is never turned on by the assistant (see the osu! notice of 2026-10-14, https://osu.ppy.sh/community/forums/topics/2254092).
engine.policy.prediction_unknown: Its prediction setting (frameShift) may or may not count as input assistance under the osu! notice of 2026-10-14; this is unresolved (https://osu.ppy.sh/community/forums/topics/2254092).
engine.filter.reconstructor.summary: Undoes the tablet's own hardware smoothing (reverse EMA). Only for tablets that smooth in hardware; on others it amplifies noise.
engine.filter.reconstructor.latency: Removes delay instead of adding it; too low a weight makes the cursor overshoot.
engine.filter.spectral_reconstructor.sum: Advanced antichatter with its own resampler. Very new (2026), few community reports.
engine.filter.spectral_reconstructor.lat: Delay is about Latency Samples report intervals (4 reports is about 30 ms at 133 reports per second).
engine.filter.saturn_hrrnc.summary: Noise compensation for tablets with a very high report rate (modded firmware). Not useful at 133-266 reports per second.
engine.filter.bezier_interpolator.summar: Smooth curve resampler between reports; an alternative to Temporal Resampler (do not use both).
engine.filter.bezier_interpolator.latenc: About one report interval behind the pen (estimate from its code).
engine.filter.scuffed_interp.summary: Interpolation or prediction for 133-266 reports per second tablets. Advanced.
engine.filter.scuffed_interp.latency: Up to about one report interval depending on its amount; prediction mode leads the pen.
engine.filter.frenet_serret_predictor.su: Predicts where the pen is going and moves the cursor ahead of it. Its author notes extra jitter.
engine.filter.frenet_serret_predictor.la: Leads the pen by design (look-ahead), so it removes rather than adds delay.
engine.filter.hover_distance_limiter.sum: Ignores reports outside a hover-height or pressure window. Not a smoothing filter.
engine.filter.hover_distance_limiter.lat: Adds no delay; it drops reports.
